text:
Maya: FYI opened a docs PR that touches the Private installer networking + KMS/HSM sections. PR #4207. This thread is to coordinate small UX nits + an edgecase for single-NIC HSM hosts.

Ashley: thanks Maya. quick skim — looks good. what's the risky edgecase you saw?

Maya: when install happens on single-NIC machines used for HSM appliances we run into iptables ordering + SNAT vs MASQUERADE weirdness. current example uses nftables and a generic SNAT rule that breaks HSM management port reachability in some cloud images.

Sam: can you paste the minimal repro rule? I can add an explicit note in the networking checklist.

Maya: sure — example we hit:
```bash
# problematic rule
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j SNAT --to-source $PUBLIC_IP
```
that causes mgmt traffic anchored on container interface to be translated. workarounds: use --source to limit range, or prefer MASQUERADE for ephemeral IPs, or set connmark exceptions for 8700/8743.

Liam: maybe we should add an explicit HSM firewall snippet and a short callout in the KMS section: "If using single-NIC hosts, ensure mgmt port IPs are excluded from SNAT". Also mention nftables example.

Ashley: agree. i'll add a short bullet in the install checklist and file a small follow-up PR for the HSM policy snippet unless you want to include it in #4207?

Maya: include it in #4207 if it's small — I already changed the install-playbook page and the private/vpc quickstart. added a TODO comment where the snippet should go: https://redwood.internal/docs/pr/4207

docs-bot: Automated linkchecker: found one broken link in the PR — private/onprem/kms -> 404. Please update before merging. :robot_face:

Sam: noted. Maya, can you point which link? I can push fix.

Maya: it's on the "Key management" heading — the anchor changed after the refactor. I updated the anchor in the docs but missed the crosslink from the installer page. i'll push a second commit in ~30m.

Liam: also add one-line migration note for Dedicated customers who migrate on-prem: "When switching from a split-network to single-NIC topology, review HSM management IPs and NAT rules; see troubleshooting section." keeps support requests down.

Ashley: leaving a quick style nit — use code font for ports (e.g., `8700`) and prefer concrete commands instead of prose. small, but helps users copy/paste.

Maya: will do. plan: (1) fix anchor + broken link, (2) add nftables + iptables snippets and explicit SNAT exception, (3) add migration callout. i'll ping when pushed.

Sam: if you want a final review I'll take it after commits. thx :thumbsup: 

Maya: pushed commit 2 with link fixes and new nftables snippet. PR now: https://redwood.internal/docs/pr/4207

Ashley: quick thumbs — LGTM on the changes I saw. lint alert suppressed for the generated table of ports.

docs-bot: CI: docs lint passed; linkcheck pending. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Liam: leaving one request — add a short example of connmark rule to exclude mgmt ports, eg:
```bash
nft add rule nat postrouting tcp dport {8700,8743} counter accept
```
would be helpful.

Maya: added that exact line in the KMS troubleshooting subsection.

Sam: cool. merging once linkcheck is green. thanks everyone.
